protocol.definition: All 20 of 39 FP32 v16 naturally selected/public cases with median direct / public < 1. Ranked by the published synchronized calls, no significance filter.
protocol.reproducibility: Two independent cold compilations on distinct initially idle cards for each of the 20. Revalidate ordinary random seeds, output lifetime and production FP32 tolerances. No changes to production F06 sources or route policy.
protocol.timings: Same prepared FX graph, manager and selected/eligible compiled callables; switch public committed plan outside the timer. 24 randomized forward/reverse blocks, seven synchronized samples per arm after two warm calls; paired difference of block medians in us. Device times come from separate standard calibration capture, cannot be added to wall time.
protocol.attribution: The 1 us threshold describes repeatability only; it is not an admission threshold or confidence interval. Positive delta = slower than direct eager. Bare plan includes its launch and output allocation.
protocol.diagnostic: Separate processes for two-kernel allowance, split reductions, disabled size heuristic, single-value special checks, identical SDNN executable launcher comparison, and pure PyTorch eager numerical controls. Alternative launch experiment used ordinary inputs and fresh output, with executable and stream held constant.
